title: Getting Help [man, --help]
description:
# Getting Help
You don't need to memorize every command. Two ways to get help:

## man
`man` opens the manual page for a command:
```bash
man ls
man grep
man chmod
```
Use arrow keys to scroll, `q` to quit.

## --help
Most commands support `--help` for a quick summary:
```bash
ls --help
grep --help
```

Shorter than `man`, shows flags and usage.

## Common flag conventions:
- `-h` or `--help` - show help
- `-v` or `--version` - show version
- `-r` or `-R` - recursive
- `-f` - force
- `-n` - number/count
- Single dash = short flag (`-a`)
- Double dash = long flag (`--all`)
- Short flags can combine: `ls -la` = `ls -l -a`
